text:
The morning supervisor noted a concern about pet arrivals after reading your letter, and we understand your complaint is that the handoff and boarding experience for your animal felt poorly managed and left you frustrated. We are sorry for the strain that caused. Aurelia Skyways treats live-animal travel as a care issue first and a schedule issue second, because safety takes priority over speed in every journey. That means the Companion Animal Travel Desk works with the booking team, the ramp team, and the welcome team to keep each stage steady from check-in through pickup.

We reviewed the file and the delay was handled under our standard disruption process. <<FACT F109>> We know a policy on paper does not erase the stress of waiting with a pet, especially when the plan you were given does not match what happened at the airport. That mismatch should have been explained sooner and more clearly, and we are pushing that point back to the station team.

Your report also helps us tighten the handoff between the curbside team and the cabin support staff. When a pet is in our care, the traveler should hear plain updates, see calm handling, and get consistent guidance. If that did not happen, then we missed the mark and we own that. The case has been routed for a stepwise review, and the findings will be used in staff coaching so the same lapse is less likely to repeat.

If you travel with Aurelia Skyways again, the Companion Animal Travel Desk will keep a closer watch on the coordination notes and make sure the next contact is cleaner and more direct. We appreciate you speaking up, because complaints like yours help us improve the way we serve pets and the people who love them.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
